probe: parallel writer acceptance on the pinned runtime
method: POST /v1/fleet/runs with one `parallel` workflow holding two builder-role tasks. The run was never started; it was stopped immediately after creation so no inference was spent.
result: The pinned runtime accepted two parallel write-capable tasks that declare the same repository root. It did not reject the overlapping write scope at creation time, contrary to the documented `overlapping effective write roots are rejected` note in docs/RUNTIME_API.md.
consequence: Mona does not rely on the engine to prevent two builders sharing one mutable tree. Parallel launch stays refused in Mona (ADR-010) and every launch is one serial task.
cleanup: Both probe runs were stopped with POST /v1/fleet/runs/{run_id}/stop before any worker was started; no task was ever leased.
